summary: Custom decision environments need AAP 2.5 or later, EDA and Ansible Builder 3.0+, and the base image must match the platform version: registry.redhat.io/ansible-automation-platform-24|25/de-minimal-rhel9 (or rhel8) for 2.4/2.5, and ansible-automation-platform-26/de-minimal-rhel9:latest for 2.6.
questions: Which decision environment image do I use for AAP 2.6?
